posts.post_subject: First holo with Analoge technologie laser.
posts.content_md:
First holo made with Analoge Technologie mode hop free laser.

 It is:

 Egypt Queen holo.

 Laser 655 nm / 35mw.

 Holoplate Ultimate ( testplate ).

 1 sec exposure time.

 Halogen light.

 The picture is not sharp ( i shoot it with a very old digital camera ).

 By the way i removed the collimator lens and replaced it by another one

 with much better results ( Less bulls eye patterns ).

![Image](http://www.myfilestash.com/userfiles/tirex/queen%20at.jpg)
